gloss: behind someone's back; in secret; covertly

definitions.gloss: behind someone's back; in secret; covertly
definitions.explanation: Doing something secretly or without the knowledge of the person involved, often with negative implications.

definitions.gloss: behind the scenes; out of the spotlight
definitions.explanation: Working or contributing quietly without public recognition, often with positive implications.

examples.japanese: {陰|かげ}で⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: To speak ill of someone behind their back.

examples.japanese: {陰|かげ}で⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧わからない。
examples.english: You don't know what they're doing in secret.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陰|かげ}で⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}していた→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently he was secretly practicing behind the scenes.

examples.japanese: {陰|かげ}で⟦{支|ささ}えて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}する→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm grateful to those who supported me behind the scenes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陰|かげ}で{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}していた→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Behind the success, many people were working hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{表舞台|おもてぶたい}→表舞台：20605_omotebutai⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{陰|かげ}で⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are people who are active behind the scenes, not in the spotlight.

notes:
Used as an adverbial expression meaning either "behind someone's back" (negative nuance) or "behind the scenes" (often positive, implying quiet support). The kanji ⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧ means shadow, shade, or hidden side.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陰|かげ}で⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to badmouth someone behind their back
- {陰|かげ}で⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧: to support behind the scenes
- {陰|かげ}で⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧: to work hard out of the spotlight
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陰|かげ}で: behind the success

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧: secretly; stealthily — more casual, focuses on the sneaky action
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: behind the scenes; covertly — similar meaning but can imply more scheming
- ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: from the shadows; quietly — a positive variant meaning discreet support

USAGE:
⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧ (hidden side, shadow) and ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧ (shadow cast by light) are homophones but written with different kanji. In this expression, ⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧ emphasizes the hidden or unseen aspect.
